verdict.rationale: Gitea's own marketing says it can be extended with 'our API and webhooks' to build custom workflows. This is a first-party claim of outbound webhooks, but the pack has no documentation of how to register a webhook, which events are available, payload formats, delivery or retry behavior, or signing. The Slack/Discord sync is a chat-app integration and does not count. missing for 10: documented webhook registration (UI/API), list of subscribable event types, payload schema, delivery/retry and signature verification details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Extend Gitea's functionality with our API and webhooks, creating custom workflows to match your unique needs.
